attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path
FROM code.files f
WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.imported_file_id
    FROM code.imports i
    WHERE i.module_name = 'httpx'
      AND i.imported_file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE)
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT t.target_file_id
    FROM code.test_links t
    WHERE t.reason = 'import'
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s.file_id
    FROM code.symbols s
    WHERE s.name LIKE 'test_%'
      AND s.file_id = f.file_id
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s.file_id
    FROM code.symbols s
    WHERE s.name LIKE 'test_%'
      AND s.qualname LIKE '%' || f.file_id || '%'
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT t.target_file_id
    FROM code.test_links t
    WHERE t.reason = 'import' AND t.imported_file_id IN (
      SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'tests/%' OR file_id LIKE '%/tests/%'
    )
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id;

request:
Which Python files that are not test files (every file under tests/, including helpers such as tests/common.py and conftest.py, is a test file) have no associated test file at all, meaning no test file imports that module directly (importing only the top-level httpx package counts as importing httpx/__init__.py, not its submodules) and no test file's name is exactly test_ followed by the source file's name (e.g. test_asgi.py for asgi.py; test_decoders.py does not match _decoders.py)?
